Bridge $100 of USDC into Sui from an exchange or another chain, and confirm it arrived before the next step. Cost: about $4 of gas plus the bridge fee. Time: 10 minutes.
Deposit $100 into a Aftermath afLP vault on Sui and hold the vault shares. Cost: $100 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Move a slice of the vault position into a second Aftermath afLP vault on another chain it supports. Cost: about $3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.
Do one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote, so the wallet shows steady use. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Follow Aftermath afLP's official account and join its community, and check its own points or rewards page once a week for new tasks. Cost: nothing but the time. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot, and do not churn in and out. Cost: the $100 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.
